3. Board and Community Workshop: Middle Schools   
4. Caucus   
4.1 Purpose 
The purpose of the caucus is to discuss the 2026-2027 Portland Board of Public Education 
Chairperson and Vice Chairperson and come to an agreement on nominations being 
brought forward at the first official meeting of the 2026-2027 Portland Board of Public 
Education. All votes taken tonight are considered straw votes and are not binding. Official 
nominations and votes will be taken at the December 15, 2026 Portland Board of Public 
Education meeting which will be held in a hybrid fashion with some members attending 
through Zoom and others in person here at Casco Bay High School beginning at 6:00 pm.
